title: Unity VFX Entirely by AI (6.2 Astra) - Knockback
author: KorvinNasa13
selftext:
My previous post: [here](https://www.reddit.com/r/aigamedev/comments/1xzoe59/comment/19szkwjoe9o8z/?context=3)

This time I tried adding more motion, different transitions, and more complex timing.

comments.author: Xinnobun
comments.body: Lookin' good, what game are you planning on creating with these VFX?

replies.author: KorvinNasa13
replies.body:
Thanks! I don't have any plans to make a game with these effects. Just experimenting for now. I'm a Technical/VFX Artist myself and I'm curious to see how far I can push these skills compared to raw AI.

Nice thing is that AI can already generate a pretty solid base for an effect and then you can just refine it from there.

replies.author: KorvinNasa13
replies.body: Thanks mate, there's still a lot of experimenting ahead.
